about: A knife: a short single-edged blade in a wooden or bone handle. The tool that cuts plants and flesh; a dagger is a weapon class of its own.

hold_class.source: tools/characters/attach_kinds.json (blade's classes; holding.md: tools keep their own class)

hands.source: holding.md section 1: a tool goes in the main hand

lead.source: D463: the main hand, the left on a left-handed body (holding.md Mirroring)

grip_type.source: D562: in hand, a power grip closed by touch on the handle

slots.name: blade
slots.joins: its shoulder (the tang's section at the blade's base) takes the handle or a guard; its tang runs down -Y

slots.name: handle
slots.joins: a handle round the tang from the shoulder (or under a guard) to the tang's end

slots.name: bolster
slots.joins: its slot on the blade's shoulder

slots.name: butt
slots.joins: its bore on the tang's end

grip.how: the middle of the handle between shoulder (or bolster) and end (D546's blade rule): the item's origin

edge.how: the blade's edge points (edge.lower, edge.upper along +Y, its one edge on -Z) carried through

held.how: a tool has no ready pose: the Tool stance holds no guard (holding.md), so in hand it is carried until used

used.how: a cut plays the walker's Sword_Attack and a use its Interact (terra_walker::figure); items.ron's tool.cuts say what it cuts

open.why: a knife's own cut, keyed so its edge leads

carried.how: in the one-handed tool's carry pose, its point forward and down (attachment.md Carried)

stowed.how: a one-handed blade at the hip away from the main hand, mirrored for a left-handed body

open.why: the turn and offset on the socket are not set (attachment.md Stowed's next step); a sheath is a belt look not made

blocking.how: a tool does not block: the Tool stance's off button is the build menu (holding.md)

animation.how: none yet of its own: the Tool stance plays the walker's use and strike clips

open.why: a knife's use set (holding.md's count, the tools' three)

length_m.source: art/held/knife.json length; the look's bounds measured 0.260

mass_kg.source: the blade and a 0.019 m wooden handle 0.11 m long (670 kg/m^3, recalled), 0.02 kg; a stand-in until its parts are weighed

head_mass_kg.source: a 15 cm knife blade (recalled; the look's blade alone measured 15.9 by 4.4 by 1.3 cm, research/2026-10-28-assembled-parts-art.md section 4)

balance_m.source: computed from the blade's middle at 0.18 m and the handle's middle, from the grip

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's I = m (b^2 + L^2/12) on the numbers above

grip_diameter_m.source: the knife look's handle across, median (research/2026-10-28-assembled-parts-art.md section 4)

inertia_kgm2.source: D459's tempo clamp 0.85 to 1.15: I_ref/1.15^2 to I_ref/0.85^2

head_mass_kg.source: the inertia band at the reference's length, solved for the blade (-23% to +36%)

balance_m.source: the inertia band at the reference's mass and length, solved for the balance

envelope.state: computed from stand-in masses; no knife clips keyed for any item
